value_conventions.multiline_text: replace embedded CR/LF with literal \n in free-text CSV columns

stable_id_algorithm.source_ids: Preserve accepted surface_id and trace_id values.

source_pointer_syntax.literal_segments: Use RFC 6901 segment decoding: ~0 represents ~ and ~1 represents /.
source_pointer_syntax.single_wildcard: * matches exactly one array element or object member segment.
source_pointer_syntax.recursive_wildcard: ** matches zero or more descendant segments.
source_pointer_syntax.record_relative_pointers: subject_id_pointer and evidence_pointers are evaluated relative to each record matched by record_pointer.
source_pointer_syntax.evaluation: Evaluate every pattern only against its declared source_role; preserve source array order before deterministic output sorting.

evidence_reference_parsing.identity_rule: Preserve the complete accepted token. Derive source_reference_id from subject_type, subject_id, evidence_raw, line_start, and line_end.
evidence_reference_parsing.separator: Use the first colon as the structural separator only after applying the ordered match rules.

rules.evidence_value: substring after the issue-qualified prefix; evidence_raw retains the issue number
